title: Task Desk
summary: A personal task list with completion and reload persistence.
background: A learner needs a short local list of work.
problems: Tasks disappear or cannot be completed in unreliable lists

features.description: Create tasks, complete them, and retain them across reloads

data.description: Title and completion stored in browser localStorage under task-desk

constraints: Single local user; no remote database or account required

acceptanceCriteria.description: A nonempty task can be added and blank tasks rejected
acceptanceCriteria.verification: Add Review notes and confirm it appears; attempt a blank task and verify no new row
Click Complete on Review notes and verify a completed state and disabled Completed button
Add and complete a task, inspect localStorage task-desk, reload and confirm both task and state remain

aiAssessment.rationale: Deterministic task tracking needs no AI
